<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Phoenix Ward](/Spells.aspx?ID=1360)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 120

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You raise a fiery shield around yourself, gaining resistance 10 to fire. If you take fire damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points, the _phoenix ward_ absorbs any damage beyond the amount that would bring you to 1 Hit Point. The ward then heals you in a brilliant display of flames in the shape of a [phoenix's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=330) wings and envelop you in light. You regain Hit Points equal to 4d8 + the absorbed damage; this is a [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89) [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509) effect. The _phoenix ward_ then ends, and you can't cast it again for 24 hours.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The healing increases by 1d8.
name: Phoenix Ward
